Context: Ans.

Under Section 60 (1) of Code of Civil Procedure, the portion of the salary which is under attachment either continuously or intermittently for a total period of 24 months shall be exempt from attachment until the expiry of a further period of 12 months. The same attachment order cannot be enforced again after the expiry of 12 months. Though the attachment is for { 4,86,650, the total amount that can be recovered from the salary of the officer will be only { 4,83,634.
